title: Movie and TV studio work
summary: He worked in films with Bobby Troup and on the Lucy Show, Bill Cosby, This Is Your Life and the Nancy Wilson Show.

blocks.x: But I've been doing quite a bit of movie work around here, because --
I did quite a few movies with Bobby Troup, you know.

Well, let's see, the last one I did with him was with Chad Everett, 'The First was to Fight', another one was Banning, and something. You know, Bobby's very active in the acting role, you know, acting field. That's another one of his many talents. So I've done quite a few with him, and as you know I've done quite a few TV shows here. I've got to make some money. Well, I did the 'Lucy Show'.
the "Bill Cosby Show," "This is Your Life," "Nancy Wilson Show," to name a few. You know.
